races.verdict: CINNODIN took a clear step back in the right direction in a change of headgear when fourth at Uttoxeter 3 weeks ago and may still have a bit of untapped potential as a stayer, so he receives the tentative vote. The Wise Traveller isn't getting any younger, but is only 2 lb higher than for his C&D success in May and is capable fresh. CINNODIN THE WISE TRAVELLER (IRE) INDIAN SUNBIRD (IRE)

races.display_title: Everards Of Leicestershire Handicap
races.verdict: It could be worth chancing SEVEN QUESTIONS before the benefit of market clues. The 2024 Palace House winner has found life tough since landing a gamble at Goodwood in May but has dropped to a career-low mark consequently and could be set for a revival with Billy Loughnane up back at a track where he won easily on his only other visit. Forager came clear readily at Bath last week and has obvious claims under a penalty. Ziggy's Triton and Brummell are a couple of the other key players. SEVEN QUESTIONS (IRE) FORAGER ZIGGY'S TRITON (IRE)

races.verdict: Having turned a C&D handicap into a one-sided affair last month, MOONSHINE GIRL hadn't been fully asked for her effort when slipping up at Listowel 11 days ago. Returned to this venue, she can get back on the up. Fire Coral won that aforementioned race and she will doubtless give it another good go, while Western Shores is a potential improver for her leading yard. MOONSHINE GIRL (IRE) FIRE CORAL WESTERN SHORES (IRE)
